**Soot Flower Herb Paste** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

An herb paste made by boiling a Toxic Soot Flower in water.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Toxic Soot Flower | | Toxic Soot Flower Paste (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station after having picked a Toxic Soot Flower for the first time.
